confirmed_question_defects.finding: The v1 instruction first selected the first-mentioned reason when the main reason was not stated, then later prescribed a fixed category priority. These rules can disagree for the same multi-theme comment.
confirmed_question_defects.repair: Use an explicitly identified main reason when present; otherwise use the first actual reason mentioned, ignoring negated themes. Remove category-priority fallback.

confirmed_question_defects.finding: The v1 instructions said a differing value wins over missing elements, but the inconsistent-elements criterion required every listed element to have a value. The option criteria therefore disagreed about a mixed case.
confirmed_question_defects.repair: Make a conflicting value take precedence whether or not a different required element is missing; classify missing only when no conflicting value exists; align the option criteria.

confirmed_question_defects.finding: Instructions defined an instance as an event/period plus what the employee did, while criteria allowed an event, deliverable, or period without the employee-specific action/work product.
confirmed_question_defects.repair: Require a complete employee-specific instance in instructions and criteria; naming a period/event alone is not an example and does not count as an instance.
